summary: This clinical trial is studying how a type of medicine called an SGLT2 inhibitor affects kidney health in people with type 2 diabetes and diabetic kidney disease. The study plans to enroll 20 participants who are between 18 and 80 years old. During the trial, participants will take the medication and have tests such as kidney scans and small tissue samples taken. The trial is currently Recruiting and is sponsored by the University of Michigan.
